Indikator 7a+7b is a specific quality indicator utilized within the Danish ADHD Database (ADHD-DATABASEN) [^src1]. Its primary function is to measure whether patients have successfully passed the primary school leaving examination (*folkeskolens afgangseksamen*) [^src1]. 

This indicator is evaluated in the 2023–2024 annual report for the ADHD Database, a document prepared by RKKP that underwent a formal consultation period from December 2024 to January 2025 [^src1]. During this review, the five Danish regions provided feedback on the implementation of various quality metrics, highlighting systemic challenges such as capacity limitations, staff shortages, and data quality issues stemming from referrals to private actors [^src1]. Within this context, Region Zealand specifically addressed Indikator 7a+7b, agreeing that it is an important metric but emphasizing that its application requires the integration of the patient's recovery process [^src1].
